configuration.limits: Layer 0 was chosen post hoc after examining the prior contribution-ablation study. This new design and implementation were sealed before new outcomes; this is not project-level preregistration. Validation was repeatedly examined and is not an independent test. Source seeds (n=5) are replication units; batches, tokens, alphas, layers and cells are nested measurements. The recipient context includes its own pre-addition residual representation and subsequent computation, not downstream weights alone. Donor and recipient share seed/model type; no alignment, norm matching, weight transplantation or training is performed. Usefulness is confined to tested recipient contexts, not universally better semantic information. Q is an evaluation compatibility interaction that can reflect coordinate mismatch, scaling, routing and subsequent use. Reciprocal harm does not prove semantic co-specialization. Frozen expert/router weights and biases do not learn. Fractional attenuation has different absolute sizes across donors, but fixed donor/alpha perturbations are identical across recipients. Norms and cosines do not establish usefulness or explain CE causally. Sparse-versus-unpruned donor perturbations can also differ in absolute magnitude. No percentage of recovery, training counterfactual, ticket mechanism, safe pruning rule or generalization beyond this architecture/mask family/window is identified. Nonmonotone curves and negative effects are retained.
